mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision on the TLS backend is rustls, chosen because it has better defaults.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision on the TLS backend is rustls, chosen for its better defaults.

That comes from decision #11, which is the only TLS-backend decision on record. I checked the other records too: #22 (verification on all builds) and #25 (https everywhere) cover certificate verification and transport, not which backend to use. The document doesn't mention the earlier OpenSSL remark, since #11 replaced it as the backend choice.

This is a Go/gin repo, and rustls is a Rust library. The record doesn't say how it would be used here, so I left that out of the document.

The Bash call that first tried to create the file returned a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.
